headline: JX to wrap Asia tour with Busan encore on Jan 1-3
sub: Kim Jaejoong and Kim Junsu close their 6-city tour at BEXCO
credit: Photo: Palmtree Island, iNKODE, LOUDFUN TOGETHER

points.title: What to know
items: Busan is the finale of the 2026 Asia tour
Tour opened in Incheon in October
Stops: Kobe, Macau, Osaka, Taipei, Yokohama

source: Source: Korean media (Star News, Sports Kyunghyang)
caption:
JX is bringing their Asia tour home for a New Year finale in Busan! 🎤

Kim Jaejoong and Kim Junsu will hold 'JX 2027 TOUR ENCORE CONCERT 'CORE' in BUSAN' from Jan 1 to 3, 2027 at BEXCO Exhibition Hall 1. The duo's 2026 Asia tour kicked off in Incheon in October and visited Kobe, Macau, Osaka, Taipei and Yokohama. Fan club presale opens Nov 27 at 8 PM KST, with general sale on Nov 30 at 8 PM KST via NOL Ticket.

📌 Source: Star News, Sports Kyunghyang (via Korean media)
